verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the enterprise-only Zero Data Retention feature, which lets users delete all data from completed tasks. That indirectly limits retained data but never explicitly addresses whether customer data is used for model training. Community concerns about sending data to a third party are general skepticism, not concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out, availability beyond the enterprise tier, privacy policy or DPA documentation, and independent corroboration.
